text: Demonstrate laziness: show how many elements a short-circuiting pipeline actually examines. Fill in the three blanks.
choices: .peek(___)                      // record every element that passes here
explanation: Verified: `found 4 after examining [1, 2, 3, 4]`. Four of ten. Elements are pulled through the whole pipeline one at a time, so `findFirst` stops the moment it has an answer — where the hand-written `filter` from the previous question builds the entire filtered list first and does ten times the necessary work. On a million elements with an early match, that is the difference between instant and slow.
